title: 第19章 幽灵系第20章 车门开了
lines: 第19章幽灵系
公交车平稳行驶着，与此同时太阳同样在下落，那一栋栋摩天大楼表面被夕阳映衬的金黄在逐渐褪去。
“济杨站到了，请下车的乘客带好随身携带的行李从后门下车。”电子报站器的声音蓦然响起。
这一站公交车上的人陡然变多，不仅占满了座位还站了5，6个人。
公交车重新行驶了3分钟后火牙狗没有征兆地转过头对着旁边的乘客叫唤了一声。
坐在乔桑旁边的是个穿着第三十七御兽高中校服的女学生，是跟乔桑在同一站上的公交车。
女学生看了眼火牙狗并没有说什么，只是人朝旁边挪动了下。
乔桑将火牙狗转了过来，询问道：“你怎么了？”
火牙狗朝女学生看了看。
它歪了歪脑袋，似乎也很困惑。
“这样会吓到别人的知道吗？”乔桑摸着火牙狗的脑袋说道。
火牙狗干脆地应了一声，看向车窗外重新欣赏起风景。
女学生见状友好地朝乔桑笑了笑，说道：“我没事。”
乔桑瞅了眼她们之间比原先多了的10多公分距离，刚想说什么。
火牙狗这时又转了过来，冲着女学生嗞了利牙，一副凶狠的样子。
女学生被吓了一跳，下意识就想起身。
“能不能把这只火牙狗收回去，吓到别人你负责吗？”一道男声不满地开口。
说话的人就站在女学生的旁边。
乔桑看过去，是一个长了张国字脸穿着灰色背心的男人。
“是啊，这火牙狗明显还没被驯化好。”邻座的阿姨紧接着说道。
“这一车的人呢，赶紧收起来吧。”又一道声音出现。
女学生听到大家这么说，也眼巴巴地看着乔桑，希望她把火牙狗收起来。
乔桑皱了皱眉，没有理会他们。
她虽然跟火牙狗契约的时间不长，但火牙狗是什么样的她心里清楚，这是一个乖孩子。
再说火牙狗公交车也不是第一次坐，都没有出现过这种情况。
“你怎么了？”乔桑将火牙狗面向自己问道。
火牙狗傲娇地侧过头选择不看乔桑。
它听到了周围人的话，以为自己的御兽师也要责怪它。
“火牙狗。”乔桑掰过它的脑袋，双手固定住，使它不得不看向她。
火牙狗湿漉漉的眼睛又倔强又委屈。
乔桑盯着它的眼睛，一字一句认真道：“我相信你，你也要相信我，有什么事可以跟我说，你知道的，我听得懂你的意思。”
火牙狗听到自家御兽师的话，瞬间激动过来。
“牙牙牙！”
“牙牙牙牙，牙！”
火牙狗一边说一边用小爪比划着。
乔桑跟它确认道：“你是说有个东西在她的身上突然出现又突然不见？”
content_en:
Chapter 19 Ghost System
The bus was driving smoothly, and at the same time the sun was setting, and the golden color of the skyscrapers reflected by the setting sun was gradually fading.
"We've arrived at Jiyang Station. Passengers getting off the bus, please take your carry-on luggage and get off at the back door." The electronic station announcer suddenly sounded.
The number of people on the bus suddenly increased at this stop. Not only were the seats filled, there were also 5 or 6 people standing.
Three minutes after the bus started running again, the fire-toothed dog turned its head without warning and barked at the passengers next to it.
Sitting next to Qiao Sang was a female student wearing the uniform of No. 37 Beast Control High School. She was on the bus at the same stop as Qiao Sang.
The female student glanced at the fire-toothed dog and didn't say anything. She just moved to the side.
Qiao Sang turned the Fire Tooth Dog around and asked, "What's wrong with you?"
The fire-toothed dog looked at the female student.
"Teeth?"
It tilted its head and seemed confused.
"Do you know this will scare others?" Qiao Sang said, touching the head of the fire-toothed dog.
"Teeth."
Fire Tooth Dog responded simply, looked out the car window and enjoyed the scenery again.
Upon seeing this, the female student smiled friendly at Qiao Sang and said, "I'm fine."
Qiao Sang glanced at the distance between them that was more than 10 centimeters longer than before, and was about to say something.
The fire-toothed dog turned around again and snarled its fangs at the female student, looking fierce.
The female student was startled and subconsciously wanted to get up.
"Can you please take back this fire-toothed dog? Are you responsible for scaring others?" A male voice spoke dissatisfied.
The speaker was standing next to the female student.
Qiao Sang looked over and saw a man with a long face and a gray vest.
"Yes, this fire-toothed dog has obviously not been tamed yet." The aunt sitting next to her said immediately.
"Where are the people in this car? Put them away quickly." Another voice appeared.
When the female students heard what everyone said, they also looked at Qiao Sang eagerly, hoping that she would put away the fire-toothed dog.
Qiao Sang frowned and ignored them.
Although she had not been contracted with Huoyang Dog for a long time, she knew what Huoyang Dog was like. He was a good boy.
Besides, this is not the first time I have taken the Huoyang Dog bus, and this has never happened before.
"What's wrong with you?" Qiao Sang asked the Fire Tooth Dog facing him.
"Teeth."
The fire-toothed dog turned his head arrogantly and chose not to look at Qiao Sang.
It heard the words of the people around it and thought that its own beast master also wanted to blame it.
"Fire Tooth Dog." Qiao Sang took its head and fixed it with both hands, so that it had to look at her.
The fire-toothed dog's wet eyes were stubborn and aggrieved.
Qiao Sang stared into its eyes and said seriously every word: "I believe in you, and you also have to believe in me. If you have anything, you can tell me. You know, I understand what you mean."
Fire Tooth Dog was instantly excited when he heard his beastmaster's words.
"Tooth tooth tooth!"
"Tooth, tooth."
"Tooth, tooth, tooth, tooth!"
Firefang Dog gestured with his little paws as he spoke.
Qiao Sang confirmed with it: "You mean something suddenly appeared and disappeared on her body?"
